title: Neural network guides a Ru–Ti–Mn oxygen-evolution electrode
summary: A backpropagation neural network fitted composition/activity and deactivation data and suggested a Ru:Ti:Mn ratio of 0.26:0.26:0.48. The synthesized electrode had measured composition near 0.24:0.28:0.48 and reported 165.2 mV overpotential at 10 mA cm−2 in the acidic assay. Model optimum and measured composition are distinct; reported long-duration tests apply only under the study’s specific conditions.

evidence.tested: Research Square v1 reports measured Ru/Ti/Mn electrode and acidic OER result.
evidence.unknown: Exact prior composition overlap and whether candidate was included in training data remain open.
evidence.ai_role: Neural network fit experimental composition/activity/durability data to suggest a candidate composition, which was synthesized and tested.

source_review.scope: Primary source checked for identity, publication date, AI workflow and the bounded experimental result stated.
